name: Fuji Reito
source: Reito is Hakuou Academy's school doctor. Good with people, he is kind and gentle with a somewhat mysterious aura about him. Combined with his good looks, this makes Reito popular with the female students. Currently single, Reito is somewhat of a flirtatious player, by his own confession. He likes coffee, and is quite knowledgeable in the subject. He also has a fondness for smoking, and is often seen with a cigarette.
